decision_question: Does provisional external context add stable ranking or downside-control information on top of the exact frozen V3 core within the retained opportunity-candidate pool?

population.daily_selection: Top3 by the arm score from the unchanged retained candidate set

decision_time.entry: next available close as already frozen in candidate_outcomes

event_favorability.forecast: tanh(profit_change_mid_pct / 100); fixed Chinese forecast-type polarity only when midpoint is missing
event_favorability.aggregation: latest available announcement per symbol/provider/report_period, same-day ties averaged, exponentially decayed mean across report periods

sector_favorability.market_record: latest sector record whose available_at is on or before decision cutoff

global_risk.aggregation: equal mean of available instruments; rolling statistics use only earlier available observations with minimum 60
global_risk.use: cash exposure reduction only; favorable global state cannot increase exposure above 100%

residualization.method: OLS with intercept fit on calibration rows only
residualization.standardization: calibration residual mean and population standard deviation; clip to [-3,3]
residualization.sector_fit_population: calibration rows with a sector market feature

arms.global_overlay: baseline Top3 return multiplied by exposure
arms.equal_fusion_global: equal_fusion Top3 return multiplied by exposure

selection_and_gates.lambda_selection: within each non-baseline arm choose the smallest lambda whose calibration daily mean is within one calibration standard error of that arm's best lambda
selection_and_gates.arm_selection: none; report all arms and do not choose a production winner
selection_and_gates.directional_pass: selected lambda > 0 and mean lift is non-negative in validation and reused_evaluation
selection_and_gates.strong_provisional_pass: directional_pass and the 95% moving-block-bootstrap interval is above zero in both validation and reused_evaluation

reported_metrics: daily mean and median Top3 net_return_5d
moving-block-bootstrap standard error and 95% interval of lift
event, sector and global feature coverage
results by window, year and sector
worst-decile mean return and maximum adverse return where available
